title: Luanti removed from Google Play due to baseless AI copyright notice
summary: Luanti（前身为 Minetest）因一封基于 AI 生成的无根据版权通知而被 Google Play 下架。文章批评了滥用 AI 生成 DMCA 通知的行为，并呼吁平台改进审核机制。
highlights: Luanti removed from Google Play due to baseless AI copyright notice
AI-generated copyright claims are increasingly used to target open-source projects
The notice was based on false AI-generated information, highlighting flaws in automated content moderation
